title: Security Hardening
description: Baseline hardening for new WordPress sites before handoff or go-live.

steps.title: Disable Theme/Plugin Editor
steps.instructions: Add define('DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT', true); to wp-config.php so compromised admin accounts cannot edit code from the dashboard.

steps.title: Force SSL for Admin
steps.instructions: Enable FORCE_SSL_ADMIN in wp-config.php and confirm wp-admin loads only over HTTPS.

steps.title: Verify Non-Default Table Prefix
steps.instructions: Confirm the database table prefix is not wp_ on production installs to reduce automated attack surface.

steps.title: Restrict XML-RPC
steps.instructions: Disable XML-RPC if Jetpack, mobile apps, or pingbacks are not required. Block xmlrpc.php at the web server if possible.

steps.title: Remove Version Fingerprint
steps.instructions: Remove the wp_generator meta tag and ensure readme.html/license.txt are not publicly accessible on production.

steps.title: Audit Administrator Accounts
steps.instructions: Remove unused admin users, enforce strong passwords, and confirm only named agency/client admins have the administrator role.

steps.title: Enable Login Protection
steps.instructions: Install or configure brute-force protection (plugin, WAF rule, or host firewall) and enable 2FA for all administrator accounts.

steps.title: Confirm Public Indexing Setting
steps.instructions: Verify whether the site should be indexed. Staging should discourage search engines; production should allow indexing when ready.
